title: Controller: Set controls rebinds one job, keeps, leaves unsaved and resets to defaults

steps.say: Drive the controller layer with a synthetic pad, without a shard or a real controller.

do.text: The rebind checks open Set controls as Options does, rebind War mode alone, keep a job with a tap of B, leave without saving, reset to defaults and save, and cancel with three inputs held. The shard-backed --pad-wheels-probe covers mounting, dismounting and the attack lock.
